You see a fridge. The fridge is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever! You can make out a closed oven. You make out a table. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a table? On the table you make out a cookbook. You can make out a counter. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You make out a stove. The stove appears to be empty.

There is an open frosted-glass door leading east. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, there is no door.

There is a red onion and an orange bell pepper on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a raw purple potato, a knife, a block of cheese and a red hot pepper.

thought: I will now take the orange bell pepper from the floor as it is needed for the recipe.
action: take orange bell pepper from floor
feedback: You pick up the orange bell pepper from the ground.
